details: DesEngs (desengs.com) is a curated, dated directory of resources for design engineers: UI component libraries, animation and motion tools, typography guides, design-token generators, micro-interaction collections, essays on the design-engineering craft, agent skills for frontend polish, and design-engineer job listings. Each entry links out to the original resource with a one-line description, and the list is updated regularly. Useful as a discovery feed for front-of-the-frontend work — components, motion, type, and taste.
